dedupe_keys.name: gcad global harmonised corpus of industrial chemical accident records 1970 to 2025

description: GCAD-Global is a harmonised multi-source corpus of chemical accident records with an analysis package on how many accidents go unreported. The Zenodo and DataCite records say it merges 525,632 records from the French ARIA/BARPI database, the US National Response Center (NRC/USCG), the EU eMARS system, GDELT news events, a Chinese ministry source (MEM-CN) and DesInventar, with severity tiering and cross-source entity resolution, together with detection and dark-figure analysis tables, figures, a Python pipeline, satellite benchmark results for six catastrophes and the manuscript. It was published on 6 September 2026 by three authors under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip file of about 42 MB. A companion replication package by the same authors argues the corpus cannot support cross-country comparison. Caveats: it is a very recent research release whose affiliations are not stated on the Zenodo record, and the harmonised records inherit the reporting bias of each source. For simulation it gives a large pooled event base for chemical accident frequency and severity, with explicit estimates of under-reporting. Related catalogue records include the ARIA database, eMARS and eNATECH.
